headline: UNCTAD Forecasts Zero Growth for Global Maritime Trade in 2026
summary: Global maritime trade is projected to stagnate with zero growth in 2026 due to shipping disruptions and trade uncertainties arising from conflicts in the Middle East, the UN said.
why: Maritime shipping carries over 80 percent of global merchandise trade, making shipping disruptions a critical factor for international supply chains.

impacts.name: Marine Shipping
impacts.why: Stagnant maritime trade volume directly impacts cargo shipping demand and freight revenues.
